root_cause.text: The libata driver lacked a quirk entry to disable Link Power Management (LPM) for the ST1000DM010-2EP102 hard drive, which suffers from hardware compatibility issues with LPM that cause random system freezes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `{ "ST1000DM010-2EP102", NULL, ATA_QUIRK_NOLPM }` to the `__ata_dev_quirks` array in `drivers/ata/libata-core.c` to disable LPM for this specific drive model.
